Interface and uncertainty assessment — P3

The exact-interface follow-up adds identification and topology evidence. It supplies no measured installed interface. The current three prototypes remain approximately 160 × 120 × 47.2192 mm design envelopes; use CURRENT_DIMENSIONS.md for generated values. This assessment remains the evidence register for unresolved interfaces; the active digital scope does not require a measurement session or physical gate. The current digital sequence is in NEXT_DECISIONS.md.

Sources: P3 exact-interface report, earlier oil-pan evidence, parameter/evidence register. The follow-up retains original downloaded bytes and a hash manifest. Its source-observations file distinguishes retained originals from indexed web observations and retrieval failures.

Decision and confidence

Identification confidence is strongest for the cataloged pan/cover family and the reproduced EPC's screw callout. The exact-vehicle EPC is on a third-party host, and the official bolt page's generic LS prose cannot independently establish Solstice application. The report retains this distinction and its attribute discrepancy. Confidence in metric hidden-interface fit remains absent, rather than receiving a numerical estimate from visual likeness.

No physical measurement worksheet row is promoted from UNKNOWN. Published screw and dowel nominals narrow the physical identification task; they do not establish installed measurements or manufacturing tolerances. Every model-to-pan placement transform remains unestablished. For the active digital objective, retain those gaps as source-labeled parameters and improve the virtual model/scenario set using the routes in NEXT_DECISIONS.md. The old measurement and coupon routes remain separate future work.

A future fit claim needs the signed clearance stack: measured nominal clearance minus measurement/datum uncertainty, process/assembly error, weld envelope, applicable thermal/load displacement and service allowance. Unknown contributors cannot be assigned zero. A numerical estimate of one contributor is a sensitivity result, not a guaranteed combined lower bound. TOLERANCE_SENSITIVITY.md provides the reproducible nominal and conditional budgets; MEASUREMENT_PRIORITY.csv names every remaining evidence item.
